title: What Marine Le Pen and Alice Weidel are planning for Brussels
lede: The AfD's Alice Weidel envisages reducing EU powers under existing rules within three years, pursuing treaty reform within seven, and using Germany's budgetary leverage along the way. Hot on her heels, Marine Le Pen is looking towards national elections across Europe to build a coalition of like-minded governments.
